checks.name: covered-scope
checks.detail: Removal of 12 to 15 cubic yards of flood-borne stones from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building in the yard

checks.name: excluded-scope
checks.detail: Transportation by barge, handling, disposal, and any increased cost to remove non-owned debris in the yard or cart debris from the perimeter into a barge

checks.name: price-support
checks.detail: Additional evidence that the estimated dollar amount from the contractor is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors

checks.name: prior-claim-overlap
checks.detail: Verify documentation for previous claims with debris removal to ensure no payment overlap; verify debris removal for the same area was performed before the July 2019 flood event
